title: Priors and the reasoning system
summary: Priors Derivation Lab v0.2 remains an isolated research prototype. All 45 current component cases and 631 accepted page declarations are complete; ten materiality holds remain unresolved. Historical declarations are authenticated; the completed 154-case machine-only inventory retains 145 candidates with producer/quality unresolved and nine typed ineligible rejected/unavailable sources. Earlier failed and held attempts remain preserved. The historical same-rule tokenizer census is complete: 936 groups, 20,266 units and all 243,192 cells, with every failure retained; this is an engineering milestone only. The separate emphasis/full-parent prototype remains unadopted. Its 25 fake utility and 11 pure observer controls have independent source-only acceptance; the later fictional V3 Phase A attempt is HELD with all original 200 records unattempted and no B_PREPARE or Phase B. Owned process absence remains unproven, so further heavy continuation is held pending coordinated maintenance. Real source data, models and pinned tokenizers remain closed. The source-quality gate stays in progress; the full 15,000-record study, 30,000-unit comparison and first-prior decision remain open.

milestones.description: The fresh source-quality gate remains unpassed. All 45 current cases have completed authored component reviews and 631 accepted explicit page-read declarations: root 13 cases/125 pages, documentation reviewer 15/253 and gzip reviewer 17/253. This is not a quality rate or legal/final defect adjudication. Original context, adverse, N/A, null and strict-check outcomes remain unchanged. The strict current-45 raw-scope/frozen-page check passed mechanically and clears none of these holds. V6 authentication verifies all 154 historical complete declaration roots and 2,068 declared pages only; original case 0170 remains partial at 31/90. It supplies no current qualification or producer bridge. The first historical 154-case current-component comparison attempt remains HELD after 52 saved files at its 16 MiB metadata cap, without a summary or complete proof. An earlier full gzip attempt retained 145 candidate comparison records plus nine durable rejected-source failures and remains HELD; its records and the 52-file cap attempt remain immutable. Typed rejected-source preparation passed 98 fictional controls, while earlier launches were held for inherited process-observation and physical reservation-floor monitor gaps. The repaired v16 guardian has now completed the whole 154-case machine-only inventory with exit zero, zero failures and zero unattempted records. The v8 summary retains 145 candidates with producer and quality questions UNRESOLVED, plus nine explicitly INELIGIBLE rejected/unavailable anchors, without inventing parents or units. ROOT and independent readback verified all encoded/decoded records, 84 executed source bindings, native/raw metadata and historical judgment joins, 458 named refs, the full method-difference ledger, 35 capacity boundaries, three terminal checks and owned process-group absence. The recorded run stayed within its original metadata and resource limits. This is completed comparison metadata only: no new actual source reading, current source/native qualification, producer bridge, issue clearance, quality pass or adoption. All prior failures, adverse judgments, original partial case 0170 and caps remain preserved. Calibration remains 1,000 selected records: 994 acquired, six terminal failures, 937 accepted and 57 rejected. Gzip engineering/storage-equivalence proofs remain distinct from source quality. Five ordinary boundary findings have exact 874c source-only resolutions with zero new readings; six prefix/role resolutions remain exact to 0ac7 and the legacy native-input issue stays separately held. The historical same-rule tokenizer census is now complete on the older five-tag a985 / source 5948 basis: 936 groups, 20,266 units and all 243,192 cells, comprising 208,620 retained plus 34,572 new cells in an exact disjoint union. All outcomes remain accounted for: 221,448 passing capacity cells, 21,736 minimum-codepoint failures, eight projection-bound failures and zero source-binding, invariant or timeout cells. ROOT verified all 936 encoded/decoded shards, the typed ordered index and full semantic replay of the 311 new log chains, while retaining the earlier proof for reused cells. This completes a historical engineering milestone only; it establishes no current 874c or nine-tag readiness, semantic equivalence, quality rate, inference, pooling or adoption. The isolated literal-emphasis-parent-v1 prototype has independently reviewed synthetic checks and a full-budget measurement on one simple source-free fixture; it establishes no actual-parent feasibility, source reading, inference, pooling, quality or adoption. Post-run supervisor assertions retain their independent source-verification limit. The proposed 69-case actual-source pilot remains preparation only, with 45 mandatory cases plus 24 strata and no old-envelope promotion. The exact source-free adapter2c8afe preparation passed 55 controls and an independent 55-control rerun, including empty native sources, complete envelope bindings and invalid UTF-8 refusal. ROOT accepted only that exact preparation. The next-stage 18-component revision d2117 passed 16 source-free controls and independent component review without a component blocker; the separate four-file G1/G2 guardian repair revision 491423 passed 16 source-free controls and independent review without a repair blocker. ROOT accepted only those exact component preparation scopes. ROOT accepted coherent source-free integration under quiet revision 563eab: a fictional 200-record metadata fixture produced the fixed 69-case selection, with 48 project files, 96 named configuration refs, 73 lossless outputs including 69 case gzips, 276 literal streams, 1,116 fictional windows and 8,096 fake codepoint-counter calls. No pinned tokenizer or model was called. Peak sampled RSS was 360,349,696 bytes; full periodic history was not retained and capacity checks used a virtual fixture. No routine rerun was performed. Actual admission, configuration of the 45 mandatory cases, real metadata draw, raw loading, pinned tokenizers, the full 69-case pilot and manual reader remain UNEXECUTED/HELD. The three-document plan was accepted for closed source-only implementation: 29 new files and 128 named dependencies retain 20 passing focused fictional controls. The six-file stored reader separately passed 19 fictional controls and independent/ROOT component review; its exact fictional one-forward response was 5,912 UTF16 units / 6,272 bytes. The exact closed-runner b5b9bb F1/F2 and monotonic-accounting repairs are independently and ROOT accepted as source-only preparation after 28 retained fictional controls. Prior failures and counterexamples remain retained. No new two-phase integration suite has run; a separately frozen source-free observer/issuer runner is being prepared, while the runtime component and closed source preparation remain separate. The 19-control reader acceptance is unchanged. Fictional-policy b5 outputs intentionally do not match the pinned-policy reader factory and cannot be relabelled as real inputs. The tokenizer dependency decision accepts only named installed-service provenance with unenumerated transitive/native components, while actual wrapper/configuration/epoch and counter opening stay held. Future saved reader responses, journals and evidence share the original growth baseline and combined 128 MiB budget. These component checks grant no actual-run, reading or activation authority. The current pipeline, prior catalog and financial runtime are unchanged by this unadopted experiment. Existing 200 development body/57 control qualifications preserve their original outcomes; current component qualification, unopened 100-parent/29-contract fresh audit, full vectors/20 geometry attempts, 30,000-unit comparison, coding, novelty, fixed-facts validation, candidate freeze and reserves remain open. Current continuation record - 16 October 2026: The 25 fake utility controls and 11 pure observer controls passed and received independent source-only acceptance. The later fictional V3 Phase A attempt ran and was HELD by a bootstrap CLI/top-level-await import cycle and parent IPC shutdown. All original 200 records remain unattempted; neither B_PREPARE nor Phase B ran. Real source data, models and pinned tokenizers remain closed. These fictional controls and the held attempt add no source readings, quality findings or prior adoption. The full goal stays active and source quality stays in progress; ten materiality holds, 15,000 selected versus the 1,000-record calibration, 937 accepted, 57 rejected, six unacquired, the historical 243,192-cell census and the 154-case inventory of 145 unresolved candidates plus nine ineligible anchors remain unchanged.
